featured_reviews.name: Balaji Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
This lakeside place is the perfect setting for relaxation, adventure, and creating lasting memories.

So if you're looking for a place to recharge your batteries, connect with nature, and create unforgettable memories, this lakeside place is the perfect destination. Come and experience the magic for yourself.

featured_reviews.name: Abinash Baruah
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is clean, mostly couples go there but anyone can have a good time by just sitting there and feeling the breeze. Go there at the evening time to avoid the sun, which is the case with all places.
The contrast that you see there is amazing, from high rise buildings to the amazing lake.

featured_reviews.name: FoodViser
featured_reviews.review_text: Boat house in IIT Bombay, gives you the best site to click photos. The nature is mesmerizing there, and as if it challenges you with its continuous changing beauty. It is the place with absolute peace and the road that leads to the place is almost like road to the heaven. It gives you thrill as well since the place has almost pin drop silence. My favorite place from insti.

featured_reviews.name: Ayan Mazumdar
featured_reviews.review_text: Ah!! The view and the atmosphere. It is not a necessity that you should be with someone. You can be here all alone and still spend a lot of time in peace and tranquility. If you go with friends, there will definitely be a lot of gossip but there will also be a time where everyone will be quiet and marvel at the serene place. This is a place where every student in the University can look for some solace from all the pressure hanging around on them for so long. A must visit to this place even if you're there for a day or two. The entry to the place is a bit scary because of the quietness and hanging bushes but worth it. It is not recommended to visit this after dark.

featured_reviews.name: Neeraj Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice place for a calm evening, we disappointed to see no boating facility from IITB side :p.
Green space and beautiful sunset view. Although be aware, there might be animals such as panthers which were "spotted" there according to the entry board.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant.k
featured_reviews.review_text:
The quality has declined; no longer the local gem it used to be.
I am a local here and have been a loyal customer of this restaurant for a very long time. It saddens me to say that they seem to have forgotten their roots. In an effort to increase profit margins, they are clearly cutting corners on quality.
I recently ordered the Pomfret Thali, and the fish fry was a massive disappointment—the plate was literally swimming in oil. Furthermore, they have started charging extra for small things like sonkari, which used to be part of the authentic experience. If you are visiting for the first time, you might not notice, but as someone who knows the original taste, the change is obvious. There are plenty of other great options nearby—I suggest you try those instead.

featured_reviews.name: Nandkumar Mayanak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an absolutely fantastic Malvani seafood lunch at Malwani Aswad in Vile Parle East. The best part about this place is how close the flavours are to authentic homemade Malvani/Konkani food, rich, fresh, and 100% true to the cuisine. The menu has a huge variety, and it’s rare to find places serving premium fish like Chonak, depending on availability of course.
We started with Tisrya Sukha, and it was bursting with flavour — fleshy clams and a sukha masala that was an absolute banger. The Bombil Fry, Chonak Fry, and Prawns Fry were all incredibly fresh and perfectly fried. The Surmai curry was beautifully balanced, and the Solkadhi paired wonderfully with the meal. Had it all with bhakri and a little rice, and the portions were very generous.
The restaurant is small, but spotlessly clean, very well maintained, and clearly run with a lot of passion. You may have to wait during peak hours, but it is 100% worth the wait. Special shoutout to the owners for serving such authentic flavours with consistency and care. Wishing you bigger success ahead  truly one of the best Malvani food experiences in Mumbai. 🌊🐟🔥

The prawns masala Thali and and Pomfret thali with crispy fried prawns and Crab masala as a side dish were amazing!
Their Sol kadi is one of best I have had amongst the best of the seafood places in Mumbai!
The fare is easy on the pocket too, fairly priced, superb service, friendly atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: yash morajkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Malvan Aswaad delivers an experience that instantly transports you to the coastal heart of Malvan. From the very first bite, there’s a deep sense of nostalgia, with every dish reflecting the region’s rich culinary heritage.
The seafood stands out for its freshness and authentic preparation, while the mutton dishes impress with both quality and flavor. Add to that the quick service, and it becomes an easy recommendation. A must-visit spot for anyone craving a truly satisfying Malvani meal.

featured_reviews.review_text: The food was average and mostly people are going there after watching few reels..

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of my favorite malwani entries in Mumbai. From outside you might wanna give it a miss as it's a humble entry small in size and no ac but trust me the food is amazing both quality and quantity wise. It's always packed so be prepared to wait.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Chougule
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this fish food restaurant for lunch, and it was a truly satisfying experience. The freshness of the seafood was immediately noticeable, and the aroma itself set high expectations—which were absolutely met. The fish was cooked to perfection: crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, with well-balanced spices that enhanced the natural flavors rather than overpowering them.
The owner and support staff were very much polite and helpful. They carried smile on their face throughout their service which created a homely atmosphere in the restaurant.
Well to conclude this will be my go to restaurant for the fish food experience with an amazing taste and a budget friendly menu.
#Malwan aswaad .... You were amazing. 🙂

name: Shirgaonkar puranpoli
description:
|| अन्न हे पूर्णब्रह्म ||
In today’s fast-paced world, Shirgaonkar Foods bring you the taste of tradition with homemade Maharashtrian delights. Specializing in Puranpoli, we make 3,000-4,000 daily, with demand growing rapidly. During Holi, we prepare 18,000-20,000 Puranpolis in 5 days—without branding—and still, queues form!

We offer catering, tiffins, party orders, and festive treats like Modaks, Diwali Faral, Chakli, Laddoos, and Sev. Our food is loved for its authenticity, hygiene, and unbeatable taste.

From Parle to far-off places like Singapore, UK, and the USA, our Puranpolis reach homes worldwide, bringing a taste of Maharashtra wherever you are!
